# 1.21.4 DimLib test dependency

`dimlib-source` was copied from the iPortalTeam DimLib repository's `1.21.3` branch (commit `467e83b`) and adapted locally to Minecraft 1.21.4 with Fabric API `0.119.4+1.21.4`. The upstream source and its Apache 2.0 `LICENSE` are included. `dimlib-1.1.0+mc1.21.4.jar` is the resulting local test build (SHA-256 `0ED2232311A88C2EC9D57B4CCAF409149EE1F5EBCB3E63837C98E8E3C5F7A601`).

This is an interim dependency for the Fabric port; it is not an upstream DimLib release. Changes to the source require rebuilding the JAR and updating the hash before release.
